features.name: industrial urban arena
features.notes: Medium-sized tactical arena with concrete and metal materials
features.quote: modern industrial/urban warfare aesthetic with concrete and metal materials

features.name: symmetrical three lane network
features.notes: Parallel routes, classically three, leading toward predictable central engagement fronts
features.quote: symmetrical lanes for balanced team vs team engagements

features.name: opposing team bases
features.notes: Balanced bases at opposite ends, shielded from opposing sniper tower sightlines
features.quote: Balanced team bases at opposite ends of the industrial arena

features.name: industrial combat buildings
features.notes: Multiple concrete-and-steel structures positioned along the lanes

features.name: building doorways and windows
features.notes: Street-level entrances and windows on the industrial buildings
features.quote: with doorways and windows for cover

features.name: central lane pinch point
features.notes: Narrow transitions between buildings where symmetrical lanes meet in contested middle ground
features.quote: Narrow transitions where the symmetrical lanes meet between the buildings

features.name: elevated platforms and catwalks
features.notes: Metal elevated firing areas spanning or overlooking the arena
features.quote: elevated platforms and catwalks for vertical gameplay

features.name: exposed stairs and ladders
features.notes: Predictable exposed access routes to catwalks, platforms, and towers
features.quote: reachable only through exposed, predictable stairs and ladders

features.name: opposite end sniper towers
features.notes: One sniper tower at each opposite end of the map

features.name: cover crates and barriers
features.notes: Evenly distributed across every lane; waist-high concrete barriers and full-body metal crates
